run_setup_wizard: run the interactive Hermes Agent setup wizard to configure provider, terminal, messaging, tools, and agent settings
setup_model_provider: configure the inference provider and default model for the Hermes Agent
setup_terminal_backend: configure the terminal execution backend such as local, docker, modal, ssh, or daytona
setup_gateway: configure messaging platform integrations like Telegram, Discord, Slack, Signal, and Matrix
setup_agent_settings: configure agent behavior including max iterations, tool progress display, compression, and session reset
setup_tts: configure the text-to-speech provider for the Hermes Agent
setup_tools: configure tool providers including TTS, web search, image generation, and browser automation
prompt: prompt the user for input with optional default value and optional password masking
prompt_yes_no: prompt the user for a yes/no answer with configurable default
prompt_choice: prompt the user to select from a numbered list with arrow key navigation
